messages:
elena: Thanks for the lively Q&A today. I want to surface one more point re: kernel prioritization and how customers might see it in the Console.

sam: quick question: will kernel rollouts default to 'safest' (fp32) or 'most efficient' (int8) variants? Customers might be surprised if perf defaults switch.

ja: Default rollout policy is: conservative by default (fp32/fp16) on production routes; int8 variants ship behind an opt-in flag and an explicit testing window. We will provide 'aggressive' preset for internal teams.

matt: for the documentation side, can we get a short blurb on what "int8 artifacts" mean for output variance? product needs something we can link.

elena: we'll add a short paragraph in the Kernel changelog and reference it in the Console release notes. keep it simple: small variance expected, recommend customers pin model version for critical flows.

ana: ops: ensuring canary matrices include driver versions 515, 525 across GPU fleet?

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: kernel-rollout-2026-03-22 on hosted-us + dedicated-eu. matrix: driver-515, driver-525. start_ts=1911110120.

matt: last ask: can the canary runs emit a small sample of matched inputs+outputs (anonymized) so product can do a qualitative pass? need privacy cfg of course.

ja: yes, we'll add anonymized sampling with PII scrubbers and an opt-out flag per-tenant. submit ticket KERN-512 for audit.

elena: New action items: - Jia: KERN-512 sample-anon pipeline + ticket (owner: jia, due: next week). - Sam: draft console blurb about int8 variance (owner: sam, due: 2 business days). - Ana: include drivers-515/525 in canary matrix (owner: ana, due: today). - Matt: coordinate product qualitative pass on sampled outputs (owner: matt, due: next canary run).

elena: closing thread in 24h unless more comments.
